Why Trust Us

Our in-house reviewers have walked the casino floors—both physical and digital—for more than a decade, providing iGaming services before joining us. Every guide is written first, then double-checked by a separate reviewer who deposits real MYR, spins, and cashes out to verify each claim. Screenshots, receipts, and regulator links back every fact we publish, and a public “last updated” tag lets you see exactly when the information was refreshed. We reject any operator that fails our safety checklist, even if it offers higher commissions.

Our Single Purpose

We don’t run a casino, sell betting software, or accept paid “reviews.”
Our only goal is to help Malaysian players choose safe, fairly-run gambling sites—nothing else.

How We Test

Every casino is put through a six-step, real-money audit before it appears in any guide:

Step What We Do Why It Matters
1. Sign-Up & KYC Create a live account with real ID Confirms ease of registration & data security
2. Deposit Add RM funds via DuitNow/FPX/crypto Checks payment speed & hidden fees
3. Gameplay Audit Spin 200+ RNG rounds + 10 live-dealer hands Verifies RTP certificates & game stability
4. Withdrawal Request two separate cash-outs Measures actual payout time, not advertised claims
5. Support Test Contact live chat, email, phone Rates response time & agent knowledge
6. RG Tool Check Trigger loss limits & self-exclusion Ensures player-protection features really work

Results are logged, timestamped, and re-verified at least once each quarter—or instantly if a casino changes bonuses, banking, or terms.

Scoring Framework

We grade each site on a 100-point scale across five pillars:

  1. Safety & Fairness (licence authenticity, RNG certs, security)
  2. Banking & Speed (deposit/withdrawal times, limits, fees)
  3. Game Quality (variety, local favourites, mobile UX)
  4. Bonuses & Value (true wagering cost, ongoing promos)
  5. Support & Responsibility (24/7 help, RG tools, policy clarity)

Scores are averaged and clearly displayed—no brand can pay to boost a score.

Editorial Independence & Affiliate Disclosure

We earn referral commissions only if you click through and sign up—but

  • commissions never influence ratings or the order of recommendations;
  • each review is written first, scored, then monetised if the partner passes our safety threshold;
  • unlicensed or unsafe sites are rejected even if they offer higher payouts to us.

A disclosure banner appears on every money page so you always know when links are monetised.

Fact-Checking & Updating

  • Two sets of eyes on every piece: writer → senior reviewer.
  • All factual statements (e.g., payout speed, bonus terms) must be backed by screenshots, receipts, or regulator pages stored in our internal archive.
  • Last-updated tags on every guide signal freshness; change logs are kept for 12 months.
  • Spot an error? Email info@casinomyinsider.com—corrections are posted within 48 hours.

Responsible-Gaming Commitment

We never glamorise gambling or promote it to minors. Each article:

  • links to Malaysian and international help lines (BeGambleAware, GamCare MY, Klinik Sos)
  • highlights wagering risks and loss-limit tools
  • avoids misleading language like “guaranteed wins” or “risk-free money.”

Data Privacy & Security

We collect the absolute minimum—anonymous analytics and the email you choose to share.
No player data is ever sold or given to third parties.

Meet the People Behind the Process

Our eight-member team has decades of combined experience at NetEnt, Evolution, Mr Green, William Hill, and leading Asia-facing brands. Every name and bio appears on our About Us page, with author signatures on each review.

Continuous Improvement

We monitor Google updates, regulatory shifts, and player feedback daily.
New payment methods? Changed bonus rollover? Expect our guide to reflect it within days, not months.
